user.title: Sign in to NaviLink
user.description: Use the same email and password as the NaviLink phone app.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: NaviLink refused the saved password for {username}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: NaviLink did not accept that email and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach NaviLink. Try again in a minute.
error.no_devices: No heaters were found on this NaviLink account.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This heater is already set up.

boost_settings.title: Boost settings
boost_settings.description: A boost runs the recirculation pump until the water coming back to the heater is within the stop offset of the heater's target temperature, then runs the extra minutes. The safety cap is the longest a boost can run.

pick_day.title: Edit the weekly schedule
pick_day.description: Pick a day. These are the heater's own recirculation windows, read just now.

edit_day.title: {day}
edit_day.description: Type the windows when the pump should run, like 05:00-09:00, 16:30-22:00 (24-hour clock, up to 4 windows). Type off for none. Saving sends this day to the heater right away. {error}

error.write_failed: The heater did not accept the change.

abort.not_loaded: The integration isn't connected right now, so the schedule can't be edited.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Run the recirculation pump until the loop is hot, then put the weekly schedule back.

config_entry_id.name: Heater
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one heater is set up.

stop_offset.name: Stop offset
stop_offset.description: Stop when the return water is this many degrees below the heater's target. Leave empty to use the setting.

extra_minutes.name: Extra minutes
extra_minutes.description: Keep running this long after the stop point. Leave empty to use the setting.

max_minutes.name: Safety cap
max_minutes.description: Longest the boost may run. Leave empty to use the setting.

stop_boost.name: Stop boost
stop_boost.description: Finish a running boost now. The weekly schedule is still put back.

config_entry_id.name: Heater
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one heater is set up.

refresh_schedule.name: Refresh schedule
refresh_schedule.description: Read the weekly schedule from the heater now.

config_entry_id.name: Heater
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one heater is set up.

set_day_schedule.name: Set day schedule
set_day_schedule.description: Replace one day's recirculation windows on the heater.

config_entry_id.description: Only needed if more than one heater is set up.
